Q1. Find the number of years for the principal Rs. 2,500, rate of interest 2.5% and simple interest Rs. 187.50?
(A) 2 (B) 3 (C) 4
(D) 5 (E) Answer not known

Q2. A principal becomes Rs. 17,000 at the rate of 12% in 3 years. Find the principal amount.
(A) Rs. 14,000 (B) Rs. 12,500 (C) Rs. 15,200
(D) Rs. 13,500 (E) Answer not known

Q3. Ram deposited Rs. 200 at the beginning of every month in a Recurring Deposit (R.D.) and received Rs. 19,656 at the end
of 6 years. Find the rate of Simple Interest paid by the bank.
(A) 8% (B) 10% (C) 12%
(D) 9% (E) Answer not known

Q4. What sum of money will earn Rs. 500 as simple interest in 1 year at 5% per annum?
(A) 50,000 (B) 30,000 (C) 10,000
(D) 5,000 (E) Answer not known

Q5. A person decides to create a fund to be invested at 10% per annum to provide for a prize of Rs. 500 every year. The initial
investment is:
(A) Rs. 4,000 (B) Rs. 5,000 (C) Rs. 6,000
(D) Rs. 5,500 (E) Answer not known

Q6. A sum of Rs. 46,000 was lent out at Simple Interest and at the end of 1 year and 9 months, the total amount was Rs.
52,440. Find the rate of interest per year.
(A) 5% (B) 6% (C) 7%
(D) 8% (E) Answer not known

Q7. Find the principal on amount Rs. 11,800 at 6% per annum for 3 years being simple interest annually.
(A) Rs. 8,000 (B) Rs. 9,000 (C) Rs. 10,000
(D) Rs. 9,500 (E) Answer not known

Q8. A sum of Rs. 48,000 was lent out at simple interest and at the end of 2 years and 3 months the total amount was Rs.
55,560. Find the rate of interest per year.
(A) 7% (B) 8% (C) 9%
(D) 10% (E) Answer not known

Q9. Sathish Kumar bought an amount of Rs. 52,000 from a person on simple interest. After 4 years he paid the total amount
Rs. 79,040 to the person. Calculate the rate of simple interest.
(A) 11% (B) 12% (C) 13%
(D) 14% (E) Answer not known

Q10. Find the principal that will yield a simple interest of Rs. 300 in 3 years at 2% rate of interest per annum.
(A) Rs. 5,000 (B) Rs. 3,000 (C) Rs. 2,000
(D) Rs. 1,000 (E) Answer not known

Q11. At what rate of simple interest a certain sum will double in 15 years?
(A) 6 1/3 % (B) 5 1/3 % (C) 5 2/3 %
(D) 6 2/3 % (E) Answer not known

Q12. At simple interest, a sum becomes 3 times in 20 years. Find the time in which the sum will double at the same rate of
interest.
(A) 8 year (B) 10 year (C) 12 year
(D) 14 year (E) Answer not known

Q13. Vijay invested Rs. 10,000 at the rate of 5% simple interest per annum. He received Rs. 11,000 after some years. Find
the number of years.
(A) 3 years (B) 2 years (C) 4 years
(D) 1 year (E) Answer not known

Q14. Find the simple interest on Rs. 5x^2 y^2 for 4xy years at 7y% per annum.
(A) (7/5) x^3 y^4 (B) (7/4) x^2 y^3 (C) (4/5) x^3 y^2
(D) (4/7) x^2 y^4 (E) Answer not known

present value?
(A) 2 years (B) 3 years (C) 4 years
(D) 5 years (E) Answer not known

Q16. A farmer borrowed Rs. 20,000 from a money lender at 4.5% per annum in simple interest. The amount paid by him to
clear the loan after a period of 5 years is:
(A) Rs. 4,500 (B) Rs. 15,500 (C) Rs. 17,000
(D) Rs. 24,500 (E) Answer not known

Q17. The difference between the simple interest received from two different sources on Rs. 1,500 for 3 years is Rs. 13.50.
The difference between their rate of interest is:
(A) 0.1% (B) 0.2% (C) 0.3%
(D) 0.4% (E) Answer not known

Q18. If Manohar pays an interest of Rs. 750 for 2 years on a sum of Rs. 4,500, find the rate of interest.
(A) 8% (B) 8 1/3 % (C) 8 2/3 %
(D) 8 3/4 % (E) Answer not known

amount will he get?
(A) Rs. 16,000 (B) Rs. 15,000 (C) Rs. 15,120
(D) Rs. 15,100 (E) Answer not known

Q20. Find Simple Interest on Rs. 68,000 at 16 2/3% per annum for 9 months.
(A) Rs. 8,500 (B) Rs. 7,500 (C) Rs. 6,500
(D) Rs. 8,000 (E) Answer not known

(A) Rs. 2,000 (B) Rs. 1,850 (C) Rs. 1,650
(D) Rs. 1,550 (E) Answer not known

Rs. 79,040 to settle his debt. At what rate of interest did he borrow the money?

(A) Rs. 2,000 (B) Rs. 2,100 (C) Rs. 2,400
(D) Rs. 2,500 (E) Answer not known

(A) 2 (B) 3 (C) 4
(D) 5 (E) Answer not known

(A) Rs. 12,500 (B) Rs. 13,000 (C) Rs. 14,500

(A) Rs. 50,600 (B) Rs. 65,000 (C) Rs. 56,000

(A) 12 2/3 % (B) 13 1/3 % (C) 16 2/3 %
